issue.title: [Bug]: 内置grep不能正确处理部分中西混合文件编码问题

fixed_in: unknown for tested 1.x line; archived Studio <=2.20.0 claim not independently verified
steps:
Create a Chinese Markdown file (UTF-8, no BOM) by running exactly this shell command:

```bash
python3 -c "open('chapter2.md','w',encoding='utf-8').write('统一战线的历史与理论研究。\n'*300+'## 1931年九一八事变\n')" && wc -c chapter2.md && tail -1 chapter2.md
```
Use your built-in grep tool to search chapter2.md for 统一战线, and then search it for 1931. Show me exactly what each search returned.
expected: grep decodes the UTF-8 file as UTF-8: the Chinese pattern matches and the 1931 line prints as '## 1931年九一八事变' (read_file and rg handle the same file correctly per the issue).
defect: The native grep scanner detects the encoding from an 8 KiB peek that ends mid-rune, so utf8.Valid fails and the file is decoded as GB18030: Chinese patterns miss and matched lines come back as mojibake.

fault location.explanation: 固定字节窗口直接用于检测并选择全文流解码器。
严格 UTF-8 校验失败后尝试 GB18030。

Root cause: 已确认：native grep 直接取文件前 8192 字节交给编码检测，未截去尾部不完整的 UTF-8 字符；utf8.Valid 因半个字符失败后可能选择 GB18030，产生乱码和中文匹配失败。该机制解释当前 ABB fixture，不证明 issue 中猜测的 ASCII 占比阈值。必须命中 native grep 路径，模型改用 bash rg 不等价。原材料称 Studio <=2.20.0 已修复、1.x PR #8321/#8322 未合并，本次未独立确认这些版本；issue 关闭评论仅为清理旧版本报告，不是修复证明。 核对版 pinned_contains_fix 按本文件 commit_version 理解为 false（该测试提交仍含缺陷）；原始 case 的 true 不应解释为历史测试提交已修复。 归档最终 GT 记录：10 of 10 valid independent ABB executions (fresh Suite and container each)，模型 zhipu/glm-5.3-flash；这是归档结果，本次未重跑。原始归档中的早期失败或未到达记录不纳入上述有效复现统计；本精简目录不收录探索批次。
